Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 19

“That tumultuous sound, echoing through the sky and the earth, shattered the hearts of Dhritarashtra's sons.”

The combined blast of the Pandava conches has a visceral effect on the Kaurava side — a foreshadowing, perhaps, of the fear and doom that awaits them despite their earlier bravado.
